Website. http://www.hotelsmariador.com/. Location and facilities. edit. The Mariador Palace is a four-storey luxury hotel in Ratoma, Conakry, with 96 Rooms.
The Hotel Mariador Palace (French: Hôtel Mariador Palace ) is a hotel in Conakry, Guinea. It is situated in the Quartier de Ratoma area of the city.
